events.title: 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 pay a club record £2.5million for 노리치 시티 winger Ruel Fox .
Having scored only one league goal all season before now, Norwegian striker Jan Age Fjortoft scores a hat-trick for 스윈던 타운 (still bottom of the Premier League) in their 3–1 home win over 코번트리 시티.

미들즈브러 arrest their slide down Division One with a 4–2 win over 밀월 at Ayresome Park , denying the visitors the chance of going second in the league. An East Midlands derby at the City Ground sees 노팅엄 포리스트 beat 레스터 시티 4–0.

The FA Cup fourth round replays witness some of the most surprising results ever seen in the competition. Holders 아스널 lose 3–1 at home to Division One underdogs 볼턴 원더러스 . 리즈 유나이티드, chasing a UEFA Cup place in the Premier League, lose 3–2 at home to an 옥스퍼드 유나이티드 side who are battling against relegation to Division Two. 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 , another team in the race for a European place, lose 2–0 at another Division One struggling side – 루턴 타운 . This means that a mere seven of the 16 clubs in the FA Cup fifth round will be Premier League members.
Dean Saunders scores a hat-trick for 애스턴 빌라 in their 5–0 home league win over 스윈던 타운. 윔블던 beat 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 4–2 at Selhurst Park .
A spectacular goal from 라이언 긱스 gives 맨체스터 유나이티드 a 1–0 lead over 셰필드 웬즈데이 in their League Cup semi-final first leg at Old Trafford.
Matthew Le Tissier scores a hat-trick for 사우샘프턴 in their 4–2 home league win over 리버풀.
트랜미어 로버스, who have never played in an FA Cup or Football League Cup final, move closer to their Wembley dream with a 3–1 win over 애스턴 빌라 in the first leg of the League Cup semi-final.
In the wake of a two-month winless run, 입스위치 타운 announce that John Lyall will be returning as team manager, and that Mick McGiven will revert to his previous job as assistant manager.
카디프 시티's FA Cup ends with a 2–1 home defeat to 루턴 타운 in the fifth round. Bolton knock out 애스턴 빌라 with a 1–0 win at Burnden Park. 맨체스터 유나이티드 travel to Selhurst Park to take on 윔블던 and win 3–0.

셰필드 유나이티드's survival hopes are hit by a 3–2 defeat 입스위치 타운. 맨체스터 시티 climb out of the bottom three on goal difference with a goalless draw at 애스턴 빌라. 블랙번 로버스 are now six points behind 맨체스터 유나이티드 after a 2–2 draw at 노리치 시티.
Andy Cole scores a hat-trick for 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 in a 4–0 home win over 코번트리 시티.

An epic Premier League clash at Upton Park sees 마크 휴스 give 맨체스터 유나이티드 an early lead over 웨스트햄 유나이티드, before the hosts go ahead with goals from Lee Chapman and Trevor Morley , until 폴 인스 scores a late equaliser against his old club to make it a 2–2 draw. 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 complete the "double" over their local rivals 울버햄프턴 원더러스 with a 2–1 win at the Molineux, which boosts their survival bid and dents the playoff challenge of their rivals, mounting the pressure on long-serving manager Graham Turner .

애스턴 빌라 reach a domestic cup final for the first time in 17 years after clawing back a two-goal deficit to beat Tranmere 3-1 and win the penalty shootout at Villa Park. In the Premier League, 첼시 boost their survival push with a 4–3 home win over 토트넘 홋스퍼.

February draws to a close with 맨체스터 유나이티드 still top, though with their lead now cut to seven points, and they have a game in hand over second-placed 블랙번 로버스. 아스널, 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 and 리버풀 complete an unchanged top five at this month end. At the other end of the table, 올덤 애슬레틱 and 스윈던 타운 prop up the rest of the Premier League while 맨체스터 시티 have climbed out of the bottom three at the expense of 셰필드 유나이티드. 크리스털 팰리스 remain top of Division One, with 찰턴 애슬레틱 second in the table. The playoff zone is occupied by 레스터 시티, 더비 카운티, 밀월 and a 스토크 시티 side who have prospered under new manager 조 조던 since the departure of Lou Macari to 셀틱 in October and mounted a serious challenge for a second successive promotion.
